system.description: A Focus for a fighter who uses every trick, distraction, and dirty advantage available.

abilities.name: Dirty Trick
abilities.description: Distract a foe so their defense against your follow-up melee attack is hindered, or conceal another action with a bluff.

abilities.name: Go for the Eyes
abilities.description: Make a hindered melee attack to impair a foe's vision until their next ten-minute recovery.

abilities.name: Scratching and Kicking
abilities.description: Your melee attacks deal 1 additional damage through scratching, kicking, or biting.

abilities.name: Despite My Wounds
abilities.description: While badly wounded, gain one free reroll on an action each round.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.description: A light weapon attack gains 5 additional damage when the target is surprised, distracted, or unable to act.

abilities.name: When the Deal Bombs
abilities.description: Reduce the first wound from someone who turns hostile after a successful positive interaction; at tier 3, ignore it entirely.

abilities.name: Fast Kill
abilities.description: A successful melee or ranged attack deals 4 additional damage, but cannot be used in consecutive rounds.

abilities.name: Incapacitating Attack
abilities.description: A successful attack leaves the target prone, hindered, and barely mobile until recovery or aid.

abilities.name: Feint
abilities.description: Create a diversion to gain an asset and deal 4 additional damage with a melee attack next round.

abilities.name: Mind Games
abilities.description: Use lies, mockery, and vicious language to make a foe lose their next turn and hinder their following tasks.

abilities.name: Knock Out
abilities.description: A hindered melee attack can render a level 3 or lower foe unconscious instead of dealing damage.

abilities.name: Using the Environment
abilities.description: Turn nearby cover and terrain into an asset, move freely across reachable obstacles, and gain a melee attack benefit.

abilities.name: Lethal Strike
abilities.description: A swift melee or ranged attack to a vital spot deals 7 additional damage.

abilities.name: Twisting the Knife
abilities.description: After hitting a foe with a melee weapon, automatically hit them again with that weapon for normal damage.
